contexts.text: When (the antediluvians) became such, they were, as of themselves, as it were suffocated; for man cannot live without remains. AC 563, Explained.
(Their persuasion) is deadly and suffocative.
No Flood is meant here... but the expiring or suffocation of those who were there, when they were separated from remains... and consequently from the Heavens.
That such a deadly and suffocative persuasion should no longer exist. Signified, Explained.
When at last there was no internal respiration of the breast, they were suffocated of themselves.
They tried to kill me by their suffocative afflatus. AC 1879.
I perceived that their Persuasive was suffocative.
This Rational either suffocates, rejects, or perverts them.
They either reject, or suffocate it.
The love of self extinguishes, and suffocates the delights of others.
These are what either extinguish, or suffocate, or pervert the influent truths and goods. AC 3743:end.

It was foretold me, before I went to sleep, that there were many who were conspiring against me, with an intention to kill me by suffocation; but I paid no attention to their threats, because I was safe in the Lord. Explained.
Hence the evil... when they come near the good (there), seem to themselves unable to breathe, but as it were to be suffocated. Explained. AC 4330:2. SE 3326.
The Persuasive of evil and falsity, and also the Persuasive of truth, when the man is in a life of evil, is such (there) that it as it were suffocates others...
With such a one. Truths and their affections... are either suffocated, rejected, or perverted.
What was the light of Heaven with them, is either suffocated, as when the light of the sun falls upon something opaque...
Is either reflected, perverted, or suffocated. AC 4612:4. AC 5032:3. AC 7491. AC 10232:end.
Objects which suffocate the light, and pervert it...
They either reject, suffocate, or pervert truths, as soon as they come to their ear, or into their thought.
This influx, with the evil... is resisted and rejected, or is perverted, or suffocated... HH 297:end.
For worldly and earthly things suffocate it...
The loves of self and of the world... at last suffocate and extinguish all truth, and, with truth, good.
When these approach an angelic Society, where there is respiration from the interior, they begin to be suffocated...
Unless the affection... Hows out into acts, which is done in the society of a number, it is suffocated...
These (external things) so extinguish and suffocate interior delights...
After the confirmations, he either perverts, or suffocates, or reflects the goods and truths of Heaven and the Church...
It is the like with a man who is being suffocated, whether by water, or by anything which stops up the larynx... the man appears to be dead... and yet is still alive at the heart. DWis 7. 4.
He cannot bear a higher joy, for he would be suffocated in it.
a. 3. The thorns sprang up, and choked them... These are they who hear the Word, but the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the Word.
Some (of the simple) stood as it were suffocated (by what they heard).
A conspiracy made to suffocate me. What it seemed to signify. Explained. SE 3364.

They did not want to admit of its being said that they want to kill, but to strangle, and thus to suffocate; for their Persuasive is such that it suffocates. Hence some want some such thing as this to have been meant by the Flood; namely, that they were suffocated one after another...
Suddenly, I seemed to myself to be as it were suffocated... (Thus) their Persuasive could strangle or suffocate others...
(The Nephilim of this time) entered into everything, not of my thought, but of my intentions, and extinguished, suffocated, and perverted it...
A sphere as of a smoke of dust breathed forth from him... involving something of suffocation.
A pool which no one can pass over without being suffocated.
The sensation about the spiritual life had been suffocated by the world.
(Luther) suffocated the understanding of those who were at the same time in externals.

A scorpion = a Persuasive infatuating and suffocating... This Persuasive is said to be suffocating because it deprives the understanding of the faculty of thinking freely, and of extending its sight in every direction... and, when this is the case, the respiration labours. Explained.
3. For the Persuasive possessed by some evil Spirits... at the same time suffocates: and therefore it is called suffocative in reference to the body...
